# clavis secrets

<p class="cli-lead">Manage secrets in the linked project</p>

<div class="cli-usage">

```sh
clavis secrets <command>
```

</div>

Work with the secrets of the linked project and environment. Use the
global `--env`, `--project` and `--path` flags to target something else.
Every write creates a new version, so nothing is lost.

## Examples

```sh
clavis secrets ls
clavis secrets set STRIPE_KEY
clavis --env production secrets get DATABASE_URL
```
